name: Generalized Marching Cubes
definition: A contouring method applied to generate triangulated mesh surfaces from the classified volumetric model, capable of dealing with both CT values and material types.
summary: Generalized Marching Cubes extracts multi-material isosurfaces by dynamically selecting isovalue thresholds per material pair, enabling precise boundary extraction and non-manifold mesh generation at multi-material junctions.
